A bill for an act relating to state government; designating the state vegetable; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 1.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[1.1482] STATE VEGETABLE. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Designation.+]

[+The pea, the seed from the Pisum sativum plant, is designated as the official state vegetable of the state of Minnesota. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Photograph.+]

[+A photograph of a pea may be displayed in the Office of the Secretary of State. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to state government; designating the state vegetable; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 1.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[1.1482] STATE VEGETABLE.

Subdivision 1.

Designation.

The pea, the seed from the Pisum sativum plant, is designated as the official state vegetable of the state of Minnesota.

Subd. 2.

Photograph.

A photograph of a pea may be displayed in the Office of the Secretary of State.
additions: The pea, the seed from the Pisum sativum plant, is designated as the official state vegetable of the state of Minnesota.
A photograph of a pea may be displayed in the Office of the Secretary of State.
